verdict.rationale: A hands-on probe confirms an llms.txt returning HTTP 200 at docs.metronome.com that indexes the docs as markdown (.md) pages, which an agent can ingest directly. A machine-readable OpenAPI spec is also served at docs.metronome.com/openapi.json. Missing for 10: first-party documentation describing the agent-oriented docs offering, evidence of an llms-full.txt or similar full-content bundle, and independent corroboration of agents using it successfully.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: PROBE llms.txt: HTTP 200 at https://docs.metronome.com/llms.txt # Metronome
PROBE openapi: HTTP 200 at https://docs.metronome.com/openapi.json — contains "openapi" key
